title: phase.set
description: host → server → client (relayed unchanged). The host announces the current position in the game state machine. The server checks the transition against the phase graph, stores the message, applies the server-side effects of the phase (join rules, role lock, new-mission reset) and relays it unchanged. Sent on every change of any field.

missionSeq.description: Mission counter. 0 before the first mission. The host increases it by 1 when a new mission or a retry starts; the server then performs the new-mission reset.

sub.description: Sub-state; NONE when the phase has none.

review.description: PDR or CDR when `sub` = REVIEW; FRR when `phase` = FRR; null otherwise.

flightPhase.description: F0 or F1 in COUNTDOWN, F2–F13 in FLIGHT, null otherwise.

segment.description: Flight segment in FLIGHT; null otherwise.

boosterTrack.description: True while the parallel booster-return track F7b is running.

contractId.description: Chosen contract; null until one is chosen.

step.description: Build progress for the phase tracker; null outside BUILD.

DataId.description: Identifier of an entry in the shared game data (`data/`): part, part category, contract, test, anomaly card, minigame, fact, codex entry, callout, console request, award, objective, validation rule, cosmetic. 1–48 characters.

FlightPhase.description: Flight phase (§9.1). F0–F1 belong to COUNTDOWN, F2–F13 to FLIGHT. The parallel booster-return track F7b is signalled by `boosterTrack`, not by a value here; F14 is the DEBRIEF phase.

FlightSegment.description: Flight segment used for pilot rotation (§9.4).

GameMode.description: Game mode (§13). Informational for clients; the server does not interpret it.
